extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and the toolbar.

extDescription.message: Shapes Etsy search results: applies your preferred filters on every search and hides promoted listings on the results page.

commandToggle.message: Turn Filter Boost on or off

popupSubtitle.message: Runs on Etsy search results only.

statusActive.message: Filters are active on this search

statusMissing.message: This search is missing your filters

statusNoFilters.message: Pick at least one filter below

statusNotSearch.message: Open an Etsy search to see its status

popupNote.message: Filters are added when you start a new search. Change them on the results page and they stay changed until your next search.

disclaimer.message: Not affiliated with Etsy, Inc. Etsy is a trademark of Etsy, Inc.

adsHidden.description: Shown on the Etsy results page when promoted cards are hidden.

adsShown.description: Shown on the Etsy results page after the user reveals the hidden cards.

adsNone.description: Shown on the Etsy results page when nothing was hidden.

adsUnsure.message: Promoted listings could not be identified here
adsUnsure.description: Shown on the Etsy results page when the detector looks unreliable and nothing was hidden.

releaseNote110.message: Searches now open sorted newest first. Switch it off below if you would rather keep Etsy's own order.

releaseNote120.message: New: hide promoted listings on the results page. It ships off, turn it on under "On the results page" below.
